lines.en: Today’s story starts in the back of a familiar classroom- close to where the main character would sit if this were a run of the mill anime or manga series.
Fortunately for some and unfortunately for others, our protagonist is off doing something else right now.
But don’t worry! I’ll be here to keep you entertained until he makes it back.
I mean, what’s the sense in constantly following Sensei around if all of the interesting stuff is going to be happening here, right?
This is no different from all of the other times we’ve spent together.
I was just feeling a little friendly today.
Who am I, you ask?
Ha!
Wouldn’t you like to know?
Now, before we begin, I’d like to remind you that these are [teenage]girls we’re dealing with.
And sometimes, [teenage]girls tend to be impulsive or irrational or whatever else you want to call it.
Do you see where I’m going with this?
Sometimes, mountains are made out of molehills. And other times, things that are supposed to be perceived one way wind up being twisted into something entirely different.
But I’m sure you’re familiar with the concept of perception by now, aren’t you?
You’re so smart.
Unless you’re one of those people who didn’t work for where you are right now, I mean.
Frankly, I wish those people would explode.
That’s something I’m allowed to say because you still have no idea who I am, or even the voice you’re supposed to be reading these words in.
But I won’t waste any more of your time dwelling on that- not when there are so many cute girls right in front of you!
Now, which of these girls do you think will be the main character of this event?
I guess there’s only one way to find out!
: Do you guys think I’d look good with short hair?
: Are you actually thinking of cutting it?
: Mmm...I don’t know. Maybe?
: Like half of the girls in this manga have short hair and they all look really cool and hot and stuff. I want to be cool and hot and stuff.
: I already think you’re hot and stuff. But hey, follow your dreams and all that.
: Why did you leave out the part about me being cool?
: So anyway, Futaba, you have any plans for Christmas? Rin and I were thinking about going to the urban district if you wanted to tag along.
: And if you’re worried about being the third wheel or something, just invite Nodoka along. I’m sure she’d be happy to be your date.
: Few things in life would make me happier.
: I’ll...be sure to check my schedule...
: Oh, Yumi. I didn’t think you were going to show up today.
: Neither did I, but here I am...
: The fuck are you doing, though? Why’s it look like you’re about to leave?
: Oh...you know...I was just gonna go...walk around and stuff...
: If you’re looking for our douchebag teacher, I think I saw him near the library.
: See, this is why I keep you around. You always know exactly what it is I’m looking for.
: You do realize how fucking easy you are to read, right? No need to be impressed.
: Wanna come with me? Or are you going to hang out here?
: Wait...don’t tell me today’s the day...
: Is it?
: Is it finally happening?
: Is my best friend taking her first step toward adulthood?
: Okay, first off, can you word it in a way that makes it sound, you know, less fucking disgusting?
: And second, I’ve taken plenty of steps toward adulthood. I watch your sister just as much as you do. Fuck, probably even more, actually.
: Yeah. You’ve been a huge help.
: But I’m really proud of you for this, Yumi. I mean it.
: I feel like it was just the other day that-
: Yeah, yeah. Whatever. Just go back to stalking your totally legitimate boyfriend and stop being all mushy and shit. It’s gonna make me sick.
: Yeah, yeah. Whatever. Just go back to stalking our creepy fucking teacher and stop being all mushy and shit. It’s gonna make me sick.
: You know, it’s really impressive how you can still manage to be such a bitch even when you’re taking steps to improve yourself.
: Don’t get too impressed. Wouldn’t want you falling for me instead of a dude twice your age.
: Ew, I’m not going to fall for my roommate.
: I’d let you join in if Sensei wanted, though.
: Yo! Don’t even fuckin’ joke about shit like-
: Bye, Yumi! I’ll let you know if you’re needed~
: ...that.
As Chika wanders off to locate the object of her ever-apparent affection, the real main character of today’s event wanders into the classroom.
And, if you haven’t guessed by the obvious mentions of self-betterment and taking steps toward adulthood, that main character plans on doing something she should have done a long time ago.
Of course, a plan is just a plan- and until that plan is actually in motion, it’s no better than any of the many goals people set for themselves only to either fail or give up entirely.
So, who knows? Maybe she’ll do it, maybe she-
Oh, look!
There she goes!
Come on! Let’s see what happens!
: Yo.
: I think she’s talking to you, Futaba.
: Oh. Uhh...
: Are you...talking to me, Yumi?...
: There a problem with that?
: N-Not at all! It’s just...not how this normally goes...
: Do you need something?
: Why? You her gatekeeper now?
: No, but if you’re just here to be mean to her, I see no reason for her to have to respond to you.
: Listen...can you like...come out into the hall for a second? There’s some shit I’ve gotta say to-
: Anything you have to say to her can be said in front of all of us.
: Oh, great. Are you her gatekeeper?
: I don’t think that’s what I’d necessarily call myself, but for the sake of the conversation, we can just assume that I am.
: Nodoka, I can-
: Shh, no. Let Nodoka handle this. I feel like she can be really scary when she wants to be.
: Excuse me, fair lady, but could I trouble you for the permission to spend a few minutes alone with your princess?
: Maybe if you try asking again without the unappreciated and irrefutably immature dose of sarcasm you decided to add in.
: I’m sorry, what’s your name again?
: Nodoka Nagasawa.
: Hi, Nodoka. Nice to meet you.
: Now, please step aside if you have any interest in keeping all of your teeth.
: Well, would you look at that? Only forty-five seconds in and you’re already resorting to violence.
: I knew from all I’ve heard that you were the type to jump to that right away, but I imagined we’d be able to talk for at least two minutes before any threats showed up.
: Listen, I don’t know who the fuck you think you are, but if I had business with you, I would have talked to you.
: I didn’t do shit, Nodoka. So step the fuck aside and let me do what I came here to do without getting in the way.
: And what might that be? Because probability shows that it’s likely something along the lines of hurting my friend’s feelings in complete disregard for-
: Nodoka...I’m glad that you’re standing up for me, but you really don’t have to do this...
: No. No, I suppose I don’t.
: But that doesn’t change the fact that I am tired of this girl thinking she's allowed to just hurt you whenever her withered heart desires.
: So if she even thinks about hurting you again, she’ll have to hurt me first.
: My fucking pleasure.
: Did Sensei say when he was coming back? Because I’m starting to think this might get bad.
: Uhh...let me see if I can find-
: Wait, no! I need you here to protect me in case I somehow get roped into this. I’m a lover, not a fighter.
: I didn’t come over here to fucking fight! But if this four-eyed freak who thinks she’s being brave or something by confronting me wants to feel tough, I’ll give her what she wants!
: I want you to run back to whatever hole you crawled out of this morning and think long and hard about what you’ve done to this poor girl.
: That’s exactly what I’m fucking-
: Who do you think you are, raising your voice when you're the one constantly trampling all over everyone?
: What gives you the right to hurt others? What gives you the right to hurt Futaba?
: Do you really feel so weak that the only way you can even pretend to be strong is to tear good people who mind their own business down?
: I...am not...fucking weak.
: Do you have any idea-
: Oh, spare me the sob story.
: I’m well-read enough to know that this is the part where your character comes out and cries about her background in an effort to explain away her misdeeds.
: Thing is, I care a little too much about Futaba to be swayed by any of what you have to say.
: So please do all of us a favor and just hit me instead of crying and risking getting your tears all over my uniform.
: That’s it.
: You’re fucking dead.
: What-
: Let go of me!
: Bullying is wrong. I will prevent this behavior in the absence of our teacher.
: Okay, that’s enough. Let’s sit back down, Nodoka.
: I know you're just trying to help, but I think Futaba's enjoying this the least out of everyone right now...
: Yumi...I-
: I’m going to tell you one more time...
: Let...me...go...
: I’m sorry. I can not do that until I confirm that you will not be harming any of my classmates.
: Please...
: Let me go...
: I no longer sensed a threat...
: Was...Yumi actually crying just now?
: You were too hard on her, Nodoka...
: Perhaps I was.
: I just didn’t want to take any ch-
: I...have to chase after her.
: What? Why? She’s done nothing but torment you the entire school year. I say you let her wallow in misery for a change.
: That makes me just as bad as her...
: It really doesn’t.
: If you’re going to go, do it now. Wait any longer and I doubt you’ll be able to catch her.
: Futaba-
: I’m sorry, Nodoka...I have to...
: Yumi! Wait!
: The fuck do you want, fatass?! You know I was just going to make fun of you again, right?!
: I know that’s not true!
: You’ve always just...done that in front of whoever was around.
: It’s not something you’d have to get me alone for...
: Yeah, well...this time it was! Now, beat it!
: Yumi, I’m sorry!
: Wha- for what?! The fuck do you have to apologize for?!
: For Nodoka! She went too far! I didn’t want her to do that!
: I was open to...talking.
: Yeah, well...tell that to your fucking girlfriend next time.
: Can you please just...stop for a second and talk to me?...
: ...Please?
: Yeah, alright. Whatever.
: What...
: What did you want to tell me?...
: So, uhh...
: I don’t really know how to do this kinda shit, so if it sounds like I’m makin’ fun of you or whatever, that’s...not what I’m tryin’ to do.
: I, uhh...
: I know I’ve been a huge dick to you and whatnot...
: And apparently it’s bad enough that your friends are worried about me even being near you now...
: Hah...pretty pathetic, right? Not for you. For me, I mean.
: I deserve it, though.
: I’ve been treatin’ people like shit for my entire life. It’s just...kind of what I’ve always done.
: And I know it should be like common sense or whatever to not pick on people...but it woulda been nice if there was like...someone who woulda told me that early on, you know?
: I...I’m not tryin’ to make excuses! I just know that...I’ve been really fucked up to you and...
: And I guess what I wanna say is that I’m gonna try and be like...less fucked up to you or whatever...
: And...
: And I’m like...sorry and shit...
: I don’t expect you to just forgive me after all this time, but I’m like...
: Uhh...
: Let’s just say I’m starting to get a little worried about how I might end up if I don’t start changin’ shit.
: I forgive you.
: What?! No, hold up. That was way too fuckin’ easy. You’re supposed to hate me.
: Like, look at that Nodoka girl. I didn’t speak a word to her at all until today and she fuckin’ despises me. If anyone should hate me even more than that, it’s you.
: You’re right.
: I should hate you more.
: I lost track of how many times things you’ve said to me have made me cry or...run to Sensei’s office for help or...
: Or just acknowledgment that I'm more than all of those horrible insults.
: And I’d be lying if I said I never wished you would transfer to a different school or something.
: I would've wished a lot worse than that if I was in your shoes.
: But even with that...I still forgive you.
: But...why? I don’t get it.
: Does there need to be a reason?
: I just do.
: I’m...gonna go back to class now. But...I’m glad we were able to talk.
: And I’m sorry again for Nodoka.
: Oh, okay. Uhh...
: I guess...see you around then?
: Yeah.
: See you around.
: Hah...
: I heard all of that, you know.
: I’m really proud of you.
: Suck my dick, asshole.
: So proud.
: Apologizing to people is fuckin’ exhausting.
Yumi will no longer bully Futaba!
Hopefully!
